title: Where the Water Goes
logline: A source-grounded pilot tracing how water moves through the Yakima Basin, what is observed, what is modeled, and what remains uncertain.
editorialThesis: The Yakima Basin is best understood as a connected physical system whose choices and constraints can be shown through evidence, maps, history and lived infrastructure rather than reduced to a single drought headline.

evidence.claim: The Yakima Basin water system links snowpack, reservoirs, rivers, irrigation infrastructure, agriculture, municipalities and ecological flows.
